The problem

Apps send email through one service, parse replies with another, and AI agents have no real inbox at all.

What it does

Owlpost is one email API: send, receive inbound mail as JSON, and give an agent its own address.

How it works

  1. Transactional and marketing email from one SDK, with a timeline for every message
  2. Inbound email parsed to JSON and posted to your webhook
  3. Real inboxes for AI agents, created with one API call

The free tier is 3,000 emails a month (100 a day) with 3 agent inboxes. Paid plans are listed on the site from $12 a month.

Stop stitching a sending service, an inbound parser and a mailbox together.

TodayThe site and the API at api.owlpost.to are live, and inbound mail reaches inboxes. Sending waits on Amazon SES production access; its first job is to replace Resend in the Factory Zero ventures.

The film

Aims

Autonomous operation
Sending runs itself: a message is accepted, split, signed, delivered and watched, and bounces and complaints feed the suppression list with no one in the loop. People set limits and look at the dashboard; they do not push mail through by hand.
Intelligence
Mostly plain code. Models help at the edges: an AI panel that edits a template and shows every change as a diff to accept or reject, and screening that holds a suspicious inbound message before an agent reads it.
Growth
Developer-led, and first inside Factory Zero: Owlpost replaces Resend in the ventures that send mail today. Growth is emails sent and agent inboxes in use by teams outside Factory Zero, counted from the first of those.
The technical detail

An email API for apps and AI agents. One key sends transactional and marketing email, receives inbound mail as JSON by webhook, and creates persistent inboxes for agents on owlpost.to or your own domain. Deliverability is part of the path: separate transactional and marketing streams, DKIM, SPF and DMARC records set up for you, a suppression list checked before every send, one-click unsubscribe. It is built in Rust on the Cratefield harness and managed edge infrastructure. What exists today is the site, the API at api.owlpost.to and inbound mail into inboxes; sending waits on Amazon SES production access, and the SDKs are still being built. Its first job is to replace Resend inside Factory Zero.
